cohort: 167 women undergoing external cephalic version (ECV) at a single institution between January 2016 and June 2017
finding: The use of nitrous oxide during external cephalic version did not significantly affect the rate of successful conversion to cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: This study investigates the impact of nitrous oxide on external cephalic version (ECV) success rates, not directly on mode of delivery.
